text: Caroline attended an LGBTQ support group on 7 May 2023, the day before the session, and found it very powerful, especially the transgender stories, which made her feel happy and thankful for the support.
Caroline said the LGBTQ support group made her feel accepted and gave her the courage to embrace herself, as she told Melanie in the session dated 8 May 2023.
Caroline plans to continue her education and check out career options, which she described as pretty exciting, in the session dated 8 May 2023.
Caroline is keen on a career in counseling or mental health work because she would love to support people who are dealing with similar issues to her own.
Melanie told Caroline that she would be a great counselor, because her empathy and understanding would really help the people she works with.
Melanie painted a lake sunrise in 2022, the year before the session, and shared a photo of it with Caroline, saying the painting is special to her.
Melanie said painting is a fun way for her to express her feelings, get creative and relax after a long day, and Caroline agreed that painting is a great outlet for self-expression.
Melanie said she is swamped with her kids and work in May 2023, and that she was going swimming with the kids after the chat on 8 May 2023.
Caroline said relaxing and expressing ourselves is key, and that she was off to do some research after the chat on 8 May 2023.
Melanie ran a charity race for mental health on Saturday 20 May 2023, which she found really rewarding and which made her think about taking care of our minds.
Melanie said she is starting to realise that self-care is really important, and that when she looks after herself she is better able to look after her family.
Melanie carves out me-time each day for running, reading or playing her violin, which refreshes her and helps her stay present for her family.
Melanie's kids were excited for summer break in May 2023, and Melanie's family was thinking about going camping the following month, in June 2023.
Caroline was researching adoption agencies in May 2023, having long dreamed of starting a family and giving a loving home to kids who need one.
Caroline chose an adoption agency that helps LGBTQ+ people adopt, because its inclusivity and support really spoke to her.
Caroline said that being a single parent through adoption will be tough, but she is up for the challenge and feels hopeful and optimistic about the process.
Caroline said she is grateful for the support of her friends, family and mentors, and that she will do her best to make sure the kids she adopts have a safe and loving home.
Melanie told Caroline she will be an awesome mom and that her caring heart means her future kids will get all the love and stability they need.

Caroline gave a talk about her transgender journey at a school event in the week of 29 May 2023, encouraging students to get involved in the LGBTQ community, and she said the reactions were great to see.
Caroline said she has been transitioning for three years as of June 2023, and that reflecting on how far she has come after her school talk made her feel powerful.
Caroline said the audience at her school talk related to her story and was inspired to be better allies, and she feels thankful to give a voice to the trans community.
Caroline said her friends, family and mentors are her rocks, and that they motivate her and give her the strength to push on.
Caroline has known her closest friends for 4 years, since she moved from her home country, and they helped her a lot after a tough breakup.
Melanie said she is lucky to have her husband and kids, who keep her motivated, and she shared a photo of herself with her husband and daughter in front of a waterfall.
Melanie has been married for 5 years as of June 2023, and she shared her wedding dress photo, saying it feels like just yesterday she put the dress on.
Melanie said she wants to be courageous for her family, because they motivate her and give her love.
Melanie and her family played games, ate good food and hung out together on a recent day out, which she said makes family moments make life awesome.
Melanie said she cherishes time with her family and feels most alive and happy when she is spending time with them.
Caroline said she wants to pass on the love and support she has received by spreading understanding and acceptance, and building a strong, supportive community of hope through shared stories.
Caroline's necklace with a cross and a heart was a gift from her grandmother in Sweden, given to her when she was young, and it stands for love, faith and strength.
Caroline treasures a hand-painted bowl that a friend made for her 18th birthday ten years before June 2023, and the pattern and colours remind her of art and self-expression.
Melanie took her family camping in the mountains in the week of 19 June 2023, where they explored nature, roasted marshmallows and went on a hike with an amazing view from the top.
Melanie said the two younger kids love nature and that the family camping trip was a special time together that she will never forget.
Caroline has been looking into counseling and mental health as a career, wanting to help people who have gone through the same things she has been through.
Caroline is thinking of working with trans people to help them accept themselves and support their mental health, though in June 2023 she was still figuring out the details.
Caroline attended an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop on Friday 23 June 2023 that covered different therapeutic methods and how to best work with trans people, which she found really enlightening.
Caroline said counseling and support groups improved her life and made her care more about mental health, so she is now passionate about creating a safe, inviting place for people to grow.
Melanie told Caroline that her passion and hard work to help others is awesome and that she is making a big impact.
Caroline attended an LGBTQ+ pride parade in the week of 26 June 2023, where she felt like she belonged and saw how much the community has grown.
The pride parade motivated Caroline to use her own story to help others, and she said she is still thinking counseling and mental health is the way to go.
Melanie signed up for a pottery class on 2 July 2023 and said pottery is like therapy for her, letting her express herself and get creative.
Melanie is a big fan of pottery because the creativity and skill are awesome and making it is calming, and she said pottery is a huge part of her life that helps her express emotions.
Melanie made a black and white flower-design bowl in her pottery class, saying it took some work but she is pretty proud of it.
Caroline said in early July 2023 that she is getting creative too by learning to play the piano, which she mentioned when Melanie asked what made her try pottery.
Caroline is going to a transgender conference in July 2023 and is excited to meet other people in the community and learn more about advocacy.
Melanie wished Caroline a great time at the transgender conference, and Caroline said she would keep Melanie posted on how it went.
Caroline has been looking into counseling or mental health work more, and says it is tough but really rewarding because she is passionate about helping people and making a positive impact.
Melanie took her kids to a museum on 5 July 2023, where they were stoked about the dinosaur exhibit and loved learning about the animals and the bones.
Melanie said seeing her kids' eyes light up at the museum reminds her why she loves being a mom.
Caroline is creating a library of children's books for when she has kids, including classics, stories from different cultures and educational books, and she looks forward to reading to them.
Melanie loved reading Charlotte's Web as a kid and said it showed her how friendship and compassion can make a difference.
Caroline's friends and family have been helping with her transition by giving her love, guidance and acceptance, and the group had a picnic together in the week of 26 June 2023.
Caroline said her support network has been instrumental in her transition and in helping her accept and grow into her true self.
Melanie shared a photo of her family camping at the beach, saying the trip brings them closer together, and she told Caroline that unconditional love is so important.
Caroline attended an LGBTQ conference on 10 July 2023, where she met and connected with people who had similar journeys and felt totally accepted in a welcoming environment.
Caroline said it is important to fight for trans rights and spread awareness, and that LGBTQ rights have come far but there is still plenty of progress to be made.
Caroline is still looking into counseling and mental health jobs as of July 2023, because it is important to her that people have someone to talk to.
Caroline said she struggled with mental health in the past, and the support she received was really helpful, which made her want to help others on their own journeys.
Melanie read a book last year, in 2022, that reminds her to always pursue her dreams; the book cover shows a gold coin.
Caroline recommended 'Becoming Nicole' by Amy Ellis Nutt, a real inspiring true story about a trans girl and her family, which made Caroline feel connected and gave her hope for her own path.
Caroline said Becoming Nicole taught her self-acceptance and how to find support, and showed her that tough times don't last and that hope and love exist.
Caroline said pets bring so much joy, and asked Melanie about her pets in July 2023.
Melanie's family has a pup and a kitty named Luna and Oliver, and Melanie said they brighten up the house and always make her family smile.
Melanie got new pink running sneakers in July 2023 and has been running for longer distances since the last chat, as a great way to de-stress and clear her mind.
Melanie said she has been running farther to de-stress, which has been great for her headspace, and she plans to keep it up.
Melanie said mental health is important to her and that running has made a real improvement to it, in the session dated 12 July 2023.
Melanie took her kids to a pottery workshop on Friday 14 July 2023, where they all made their own pots, which she found fun and therapeutic.
The kids loved the pottery workshop and were excited to get their hands dirty with clay, and they made a cup with a dog face on it that Melanie shared a photo of.
Melanie and her kids have been painting together lately, especially nature-inspired works, and their sunset painting with a palm tree was made the weekend before 15 July 2023.
Melanie said she and her kids both helped with the painting, which was great bonding over nature, and that they found lovely flowers in a field on an outing.
Caroline attended a council meeting for adoption on Friday 14 July 2023, which was inspiring and emotional and made her even more determined to adopt.
Caroline said blue is her favourite colour because it makes her feel relaxed, and that sunflowers mean warmth and happiness while roses stand for love and beauty.
Melanie said flowers bring her joy and represent growth and beauty, and that flowers were an important part of the decor at her wedding.
Melanie's wedding ceremony took place in a greenhouse, and everyone she loves was there to celebrate with her, which she described as a day full of love and joy.
Melanie said the best part of her wedding was marrying her partner and promising to be together forever.
Caroline attended a pride parade a few weeks before 15 July 2023, and said she felt so accepted and happy there, and that it is a top memory.
Caroline said she felt proud and grateful at the pride parade, and that it was comforting to know she is not alone and has a great community around her.
Caroline said the best part of the pride experience was realising she can be herself without fear and having the courage to transition, which she called so freeing.
Melanie said her family helped out during her recent move and showed lots of love and support, which helped her through tough times.
Melanie said creativity and family keep her at peace, and that she is getting there in finding peace.
Melanie's family went on another camping trip in the forest, and the family enjoys hiking in the mountains and exploring forests to connect with nature and each other.
Caroline said she is proud of how far she has come on her journey, and Melanie said she is glad to be a supporter of Caroline's journey.
Melanie had a quiet weekend after going camping with her family two weekends before 17 July 2023, and said it was great to unplug and hang out with the kids.
Caroline joined a mentorship program for LGBTQ youth in the weekend of 15 to 16 July 2023, which she described as really rewarding for helping the community.
Caroline mentors a transgender teen, and together they have been building confidence and finding positive strategies, which Caroline said has really been paying off.
Caroline and her transgender teen mentee attended an LGBT pride event in June 2023, where seeing the mentee's face light up when they saw the support was the best part for Caroline.
Caroline is having an LGBTQ art show featuring her own paintings in August 2023, which she said she can't wait for.
Caroline painted a tree with a bright sun in the background after visiting an LGBTQ center, wanting to capture everyone's unity and strength.
Melanie said Caroline's painting conveys unity and strength, and that Melanie and her kids had just finished another painting like their last one in July 2023.
Caroline joined a new LGBTQ activist group called 'Connected LGBTQ Activists' on Tuesday 18 July 2023, made up of people invested in positive changes, with regular meetings, events and campaigns.
Caroline said the activist group gives her a platform to be herself and support others' rights, and that she is meeting many cool people who are as passionate as she is.
Caroline missed her city's pride parade held the weekend of 15 to 16 July 2023, but said it was a powerful reminder that we are not alone in the fight for equality.
Melanie's family went to the beach recently, in July 2023, and the kids had a blast; Melanie said they usually only go once or twice a year.
Melanie said seeing her kids' faces so happy at the beach was the best part, and that beach trips are always special times to spend together and chill.

Melanie's family looks forward to their family camping trip each summer, where they roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire and enjoy each other's company, which she calls the highlight of their summer.
Melanie's best camping memory is a trip the year before 2023, when the family watched the Perseid meteor shower and all made wishes, feeling at one with the universe.
Melanie said she felt tiny and in awe of the universe during the meteor shower, which reminds her how awesome life is and how many little moments like that there are.
Melanie said the day her youngest took her first steps is a memory she will never forget, because it put into perspective how fleeting life is.
Melanie said she is really lucky to have her family, who bring so much joy and love into her life, and Caroline agreed that Melanie has an awesome family.
Melanie celebrated her daughter's birthday with a concert on 13 August 2023 ('last night' in the session dated 14 August 2023), surrounded by music, joy and the warm summer breeze.
Melanie went to a concert by Matt Patterson in August 2023, and said his voice and songs were amazing.
Caroline attended a pride parade on Friday 11 August 2023 and said it was awesome, with so much energy and love everywhere, which made her proud and reminded her to keep standing up for equality.
Caroline said the pride crowd was people of all kinds celebrating love and acceptance, which pushed her to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.
Caroline said representing inclusivity and diversity in her art is important to her, and she uses her art to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community and push for acceptance.
Caroline said her art is about expressing her trans experience, showing her story and helping people understand the trans community.
Caroline painted 'Embracing Identity', a work about finding comfort and love in being yourself, in which the woman in the painting stands for the journey of acceptance.
Caroline said art has helped her explore her transition and her changing body, and that it teaches her to accept the beauty of imperfections.
Melanie said it is important to cultivate a loving and accepting environment for her kids, and she said she loves how Caroline uses art to tell stories and teach people about trans folks.
Caroline had a not-so-great experience on a hike recently, before 17 August 2023, when she ran into a group of religious conservatives who said something that really upset her.
Caroline said the hike incident made her think how much work is still needed for LGBTQ rights, and that having people who accept and support her means she will be ok.
Melanie finished another pottery project in August 2023, a bowl with a colourful design that she is pretty proud of, and she said it was a great experience.
Melanie said painting helps her express her feelings and be creative, and that each stroke carries a part of her.
Melanie said art has always been a strong connection for her, and that it is both a sanctuary and a source of comfort that brings her happiness and fulfilment.
Caroline and Melanie had a blast at the Pride fest in 2022, and Caroline said supportive friends like Melanie make everything worth it.
Melanie suggested a family outing for summer 2023, and Caroline suggested a special summer trip just the two of them to catch up and explore nature.
Melanie and Caroline agreed to plan something special together for summer 2023, with Melanie saying she would start thinking about what they could do.
Caroline applied to adoption agencies in the week of 21 August 2023, taking the first step toward becoming a mom, and she got lots of help from an adoption advice group she attended.
Caroline said applying to adoption agencies felt exciting but kind of nerve-wracking, because parenting is such a big responsibility.
Caroline has a guinea pig named Oscar, which she said has been great, and she shared a photo of him eating parsley since veggies are his favourite.
Melanie has a dog named Oliver who hid his bone in her slipper, and her family also got another cat named Bailey around August 2023.
Melanie once got to feed a horse a carrot, and Caroline said she used to go horseback riding through the fields with her dad as a child and has always loved horses.
Melanie painted a horse on a wooden wall recently and loves painting animals because it is peaceful and special, and horses have such grace.
Caroline painted a self-portrait in the week of 14 August 2023, and said painting made her feel liberated and empowered and helps her explore her identity.
Caroline said art gives her a sense of freedom, and so does having supportive people around, promoting LGBTQ rights and being true to herself, and she wants to live authentically.
Caroline went hiking in the week of 14 August 2023, got into a bad spot with some people, and tried to apologise to them afterwards.
Melanie made a plate with a flower design in pottery class on 24 August 2023 ('yesterday' in the session dated 25 August 2023) and said pottery is relaxing and creative.
Caroline had not tried pottery as of late August 2023 and has been busy painting, including a sunset on a small easel that she had just finished.
Caroline painted a sunset over the ocean after visiting the beach in the week of 14 August 2023, and said seeing the sun dip below the horizon was amazing and calming.

Melanie spent a day volunteering at a homeless shelter with her family, which she said was hard to see but made her feel they could make a difference; she recalled it as 'yesterday' in the session dated 25 August 2023.
Caroline said finding a community where she is accepted, loved and supported has really meant a lot to her, and that it helps to have people who understand what she is going through.
Caroline said a rainbow flag mural reflects the courage and strength of the trans community, and that the eagle in the mural symbolises freedom, pride and her own resilience.
Caroline made a stained glass window for a local church showing time changing lives, to show her own journey as a transgender woman and how we should accept growth and change.
Caroline found a rainbow sidewalk for Pride Month while walking in her neighbourhood, and said it reminds us that love and acceptance are everywhere, even where we least expect it.
Caroline said she saw someone drawing on the ground, which made her happy, and that creativity can lighten someone's day and art is a real mood-booster.
Caroline said art helps her show her feelings and freeze gorgeous moments, like a bouquet of flowers, and that drawing flowers is one of her favourite things to do.
Melanie said painting landscapes and still life is her favourite type of art, and she shared a painting of a sunflower she had done recently.
Melanie said she is feeling inspired by autumn in August 2023 and is planning a few more paintings.

Caroline is putting together an LGBTQ art show in September 2023 ('next month') where she will show her paintings alongside LGBTQ artists and their talents, aiming to spread understanding and acceptance.
Melanie took her kids to a park on 27 August 2023 ('yesterday' in the session dated 28 August 2023), where they had fun exploring and playing outdoors.
Caroline has been volunteering at an LGBTQ+ youth center and said it was gratifying to talk to young people who have similar experiences to her own.
Caroline shared her own story with the young people at the LGBTQ+ youth center to let them know they are not alone, and she said she felt fulfilled guiding and supporting them.
Caroline plans to keep volunteering at the LGBTQ+ youth center, where she has made strong connections and believes in community and supporting each other.
Caroline is helping put together a talent show for the kids at the youth center, which is planned for September 2023.
Melanie loves live music and saw a band called Summer Sounds at a show, which she said played an awesome pop song that got everyone dancing and singing.
Caroline mostly plays guitar and started playing acoustic guitar about five years before August 2023, which she said helps her get her emotions out and express herself.
Caroline said 'Brave' by Sara Bareilles has a lot of significance for her because it is about being courageous and fighting for what's right, and it reminds her of the progress she has made.
Melanie plays clarinet, which she started when she was young and which she said is an expression of herself and a way to relax.
Melanie is a fan of classical music such as Bach and Mozart, as well as modern music such as Ed Sheeran's 'Perfect'.
Caroline went biking with her friends the weekend of 9 to 10 September 2023 and saw some pretty cool sights, which she found really refreshing.
Melanie went camping with her kids a few weeks before 13 September 2023, where they explored the forest, went hiking and roasted marshmallows around the campfire.
Caroline said seeing her work make a difference for the LGBTQ+ community inspires her, and that the support of her friends, family and mentors also inspires her to keep making art.
Caroline has been creating art since she was about 17 and finds it empowering and cathartic, because it can show things that are hard to put into words.
Melanie has been into art for seven years and considers painting and pottery her real muses, finding them calming and satisfying.
Caroline said painting and drawing have helped her express her feelings and explore her gender identity, and that creating art helped her understand and accept herself during her transition.
Caroline painted a red and blue artwork showing her path as a trans woman, where red and blue stand for the binary gender system and the mixed colours mean smashing rigid thinking.
Caroline said some of her close friends kept supporting her through her transition but a few were not able to handle it, and her relationships now feel more genuine.
Caroline said she has not tried pottery yet but is game to try it or other new art forms, and that she might try pottery sometime.
Melanie visited a cafe the weekend of 9 to 10 September 2023 that had thoughtful signs; a precautionary sign on a door was not a sign of trouble, and she had a great time.
Melanie said art is both a creative outlet and a form of therapy for her, and asked Caroline whether she had ever thought about trying it or another art form.
Caroline contacted her mentor for adoption advice in October 2023, saying she is ready to be a mom and share her love and family with a child.
Melanie's buddy adopted a child in 2022 and is now super happy with the new kid, which made Melanie think she might do it too.
Caroline advised Melanie to research an adoption agency or lawyer, gather documents such as references, financial info and medical checks, and prepare emotionally, since the wait can be hard.
Melanie was hurt in September 2023 and had to take a break from pottery, which she uses for self-expression and peace, and she said it was tough.
During her break from pottery, Melanie was reading the book Caroline had recommended a while ago and painting to keep herself busy.
Melanie painted a sunset with a pink sky in the week of 2 October 2023, inspired by sunsets, and said the colours make her feel calm.
Melanie painted an abstract work with peaceful blue streaks to show tranquility, and said blue calms her, so she wanted serene vibes with lots of vibrant colours.
Caroline has been trying abstract painting, which she finds freeing because she puts her feelings on the canvas without too much of a plan, and she calls it a cool form of self-expression.
Caroline attended a transgender poetry reading on Friday 6 October 2023, where transgender people shared their stories through poetry, which she found very powerful and empowering.
Caroline drew a woman in a dress after the transgender poetry reading, which she said stands for freedom and being real and is a nudge to always stay true to herself.
Melanie said showing off our true selves is the best thing ever, and Caroline agreed that being ourselves is an ongoing adventure of learning and growing.
Melanie's family went on a road trip the weekend of 14 to 15 October 2023, during which her son was in a car accident; he was okay, but the family was really scared.
Melanie said the accident was a reminder that life is precious and to cherish her family, and that it made her think a lot about how much she needs them.
Melanie's kids were scared by the accident, but Melanie and her family reassured them that their brother would be okay, and Melanie said they are tough kids.
Melanie's family visited the Grand Canyon during the October 2023 road trip, and the kids enjoyed it a lot.
Melanie said her family is her biggest motivation and support, and that having them around helps make hard times easier.
Melanie went on a hike with one of her children on 19 October 2023 ('yesterday' in the session dated 20 October 2023), and said it was a nice way to relax after the road trip.
Melanie said camping trips with her family bring peace and serenity, and that they bond over stories, campfires and nature.
Melanie said nature helps her reset and recharge, and that waking up to the sound of birds and the smell of fresh air always refreshes her soul.
Caroline said loved ones give us strength to tackle any challenge and that family is everything, after Melanie described her family as her rock.
Caroline passed her adoption agency interviews on Friday 20 October 2023, which she called a big move toward her goal of having a family.
Melanie bought figurines on 21 October 2023 ('yesterday' in the session dated 22 October 2023) that remind her of family love.
Caroline hopes to build her own family and put a roof over kids who have not had one before, seeing adoption as a way of giving back and showing love and acceptance.
Caroline said her dream is to create a safe and loving home for the kids she adopts, because love and acceptance should be everyone's right.
Caroline said finding self-acceptance was a long process, and that she is now ready to offer love and support to those who need it, which she finds empowering.
Caroline said help from friends, family and people she looked up to was invaluable during her transition, and that she wants to pass the same support on to anyone who needs it.
Caroline said bringing comfort to others and helping them grow brings her joy, and that the journey has been amazing and she is grateful to help others with theirs.
Caroline said being yourself and living honestly is freeing, and that we can really accept who we are and be content.
Melanie told Caroline she is so inspiring for finding her true self and now helping others, and said she is glad they can always be there for each other.
